title: NDTV Indo-Japan Summit: Japanese Odissi Dancer, Indian Entrepreneur On Feeling Of Belongingness
summary_full: Naka said Odissi is her life. She also spoke about her early doubts. "I'm Japanese, and my eyes are too small to express Abhinaya," she said. She added that she has since accepted who she is.
